verdict.rationale: Notification tuning is a fair question for a chat and community platform like Discord, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains nothing on per-channel, keyword, or scheduled notification settings. The only nearby items are a community remark that Discord sends notifications and a Social SDK note about player social settings, and neither documents notification tuning.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can tune notifications per channel, keyword, and schedule so only what matters interrupts me
